terra.problem: The builders were two tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh, not three whole tribes.
The speakers were two tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh. They said they would tell the other Israelites to look at the replica, not that their own descendants should look at it.
The verses say the Reubenites and Gadites named the altar; they do not say Manasseh did.
